name: L17 · 我要多向认真的人学习
titleCn: 我要多向认真的人学习
titleEn: I will learn from people who are careful

intro.cn: 在教学楼里，刘小雪和同学边走边聊。
intro.en: In the teaching building, Liu Xiaoxue and her classmate were chatting while walking.

questions.q: 小雪的同学为什么到了李老师办公室后还向前走？
小雪的同学认为自己是一个什么样的人？

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.cn: 别再向前走了，李老师的办公室已经到了。
lines.en: Let's stop here. We've already reached Ms. Li's office.

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.cn: 你进去吧，我在楼梯那儿等你。我害怕见李老师。
lines.en: You go in. I'll wait for you by the stairs. I'm scared to see Ms. Li.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.cn: 怎么回事？
lines.en: What's the matter?

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.cn: 最近我做错了好几件事，我怕李老师生气。
lines.en: I've made quite a few mistakes recently, and I'm afraid Ms. Li will be upset.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.cn: 你想多了，做错事情是很常见的。
lines.en: You're overthinking it. Everyone makes mistakes.

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.cn: 我把简单的事情做错了，李老师一定觉得我不认真。
lines.en: But I got some simple things wrong. Ms. Li must think I'm not careful.

lines.speaker: 刘小雪
lines.cn: 有的人虽然很聪明，但是会在简单的事情中出错，因为他们认为事情简单，就不会认真去做了。
lines.en: Some people, even though they're very smart, still make mistakes on simple tasks because they think the tasks are easy and don't take them seriously.

lines.speaker: 同学
lines.cn: 你说的就是我，以后我要多向认真的人学习。
lines.en: That sounds just like me. From now on, I'll learn from people who are careful.

postQuestions.q: 小雪的同学为什么害怕见李老师？
小雪认为她的同学为什么做错事？
小雪的同学打算以后怎么做？

intro.cn: 在阅览室门口，白家月碰到了陈天中。
intro.en: At the entrance of the reading room, Bai Jiayue ran into Chen Tianzhong.

questions.q: 同学们最近都在做什么？
陈天中的爸妈希望他做什么？

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 太阳从西边出来了？这几天怎么总是在图书馆看见你？
lines.en: Has the sun risen in the west? I've been seeing you in the library almost every day lately.

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.cn: 这有什么奇怪的？我是来学习的。
lines.en: What's so strange about that? I come here to study.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 你怎么还来图书馆学习？同学们都在到处找工作呢。
lines.en: Why are you still studying in the library? Everyone else is busy looking for jobs!

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.cn: 我不想现在就工作，还想继续学习，我爸妈也同意。可我还没想好学什么，所以来图书馆看看。
lines.en: I'm not ready to start working yet—I want to keep studying, and my parents agree with me. But I haven't decided what to study, so I'm coming here to see what's available.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 你不是喜欢玩电脑吗？你可以去看看跟电脑有关系的书。
lines.en: Don't you like computers? You could check out some books about them.

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.cn: 你说得对，我记得那个屋子里有些跟电脑有关的书，我去找找。
lines.en: Good idea. I remember seeing some computer books in that room—I'll go and have a look.

postQuestions.q: 白家月为什么说“太阳从西边出来了”？
陈天中为什么不去找工作？
白家月觉得陈天中可以学什么？

words.en: have something to do with; about

intro.cn: 在校园里，李文和陈天中在聊天儿。
intro.en: On campus, Li Wen and Chen Tianzhong were chatting.

questions.q: 李文找陈天中有什么事？
陈天中想好学什么了吗？

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 天中，你的手机怎么关机了？
lines.en: Tianzhong, why is your phone off?

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.cn: 我的手机没电了。你找我有事吗？
lines.en: My phone ran out of battery. Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 前天我看见家月了，她告诉我你打算继续留学？
lines.en: I saw Jiayue the day before yesterday, and she told me you're planning to continue your studies abroad.

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.cn: 是，可是我还没想好学什么，更没想好去哪个国家。
lines.en: Yes, but I haven't decided what to study yet, let alone which country to go to.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 你可以去中国学中文啊。比如可以去北京、上海这样的大城市，那里有很多好大学，也有很多留学生。
lines.en: Why not go to China to study Chinese? Big cities like Beijing and Shanghai have many excellent universities and lots of international students.

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.cn: 好，那我上网查一查。
lines.en: Sounds good. I'll check it out online.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.cn: 我给你介绍几个有用的网站。
lines.en: I can recommend a few useful websites to you.

postQuestions.q: 李文给他出了什么主意？
李文为什么给陈天中介绍几个网站？

intro.cn: 在家里，陈天中在写日记。
intro.en: At home, Chen Tianzhong was writing in his diary.

questions.q: 陈天中觉得怎么才能做出最合适的选择？
options: 想清楚自己真正喜欢什么

lines.cn: 大学生活马上就要结束了，我最近经常被问到一个问题——“你以后想做什么”，这个问题真不容易回答。
lines.en: My university life is about to end, and I've often been asked recently, “What do you want to do after graduation?”—a question that's truly not easy to answer.

lines.cn: 我也问了几个同学，大家选择的方向都不同。
lines.en: I've asked several classmates too, and each has chosen a different path.

lines.cn: 有的想继续在学校学习，有的打算出国留学，还有的决定先找工作。
lines.en: Some want to pursue graduate studies, some plan to study abroad, and others have decided to look for a job first.

lines.cn: 我认为只有想清楚自己真正喜欢什么，才能做出最合适的选择。
lines.en: I believe only by figuring out what you truly enjoy can you make the best decision.

lines.cn: 对我来说，想清楚“真正喜欢什么”是个难题。
lines.en: For me, however, finding the answer to “what I truly enjoy” remains a tough question.

postQuestions.q: 陈天中最近经常被问到什么问题？
同学们有哪些不同的选择？
陈天中知道自己真正喜欢什么吗？

grammar.note: 介词“向”后加代词、名词或名词性短语，表示动作的方向或对象。
grammar.noteEn: The preposition “向” is followed by a pronoun, noun, or nominal phrase to indicate the direction or target of an action.

items.c: 以后我要多向认真的人学习。
items.en: From now on I'll learn more from people who are careful.

items.c: 孩子一看见妈妈，就向她跑过去了。
items.en: As soon as the child saw his mother, he ran over to her.

practice.cn: 如果有事不能上课，你就应该______。
突然下雨了，他一下车就______。
我是新来的，不懂的东西我会多______。

grammar.note: 反问句“不是……吗？”一般用来表达说话人的不理解或者不满，有时候也表示提醒或确认等。否定形式表达肯定的意思。
grammar.noteEn: The rhetorical question “不是……吗？” is generally used to express the speaker's confusion or dissatisfaction, and sometimes to remind or confirm. It is negative in form but expresses an affirmative meaning.

items.c: 你不是喜欢玩电脑吗？你可以去看看跟电脑有关系的书。
items.en: Don't you like computers? You could check out some books about them.

items.c: 你不是说今天有事吗？为什么来了？
items.en: Didn't you say you had something to do today? Why did you come?

items.c: 考试不是下个月吗？你怎么今天就开始复习了？
items.en: Isn't the exam next month? Why did you start reviewing today?

practice.cn: A：今年放假我还想去南京。
B：对不起，我没带。我把作业放在家里了。
A：我下午上班，这件事明天再说吧。

grammar.note: 递进复句“……，更……”中，第二个分句表示程度上更深一层。
grammar.noteEn: In a progressive complex sentence “……，更……”, the second clause expresses a deeper degree of meaning.

items.c: 我还没想好学什么，更没想好去哪个国家。
items.en: I haven't decided what to study yet, let alone which country to go to.

items.c: 想提高中文水平要多听多看，更要多说多练。
items.en: To improve your Chinese, you need to listen and read more, and even more importantly, speak and practice more.

items.c: 来中国学习，我学会了中文，更了解了中国文化。
items.en: Studying in China, I learned Chinese and, even more, came to understand Chinese culture.

practice.cn: 找工作的时候需要别人的帮助，更需要______。
明天参加重要的比赛，今天要______。

grammar.note: 条件复句“只有……，才……”中，“只有”后面是实现结果的唯一条件，没有这个条件就不会产生“才”后面的结果。
grammar.noteEn: In a conditional complex sentence “只有……，才……”, the clause following “只有” presents the sole condition for the result. Without this condition, the result after “才” cannot occur.

items.c: 只有想清楚自己真正喜欢什么，才能做出最合适的选择。
items.en: Only by figuring out what you truly enjoy can you make the best decision.

items.c: 只有每天锻炼身体，才会越来越健康。
items.en: Only by exercising every day will you become healthier and healthier.

items.c: 只有多听、多说、多看，你的中文水平才能提高。
items.en: Only by listening, speaking and reading more can your Chinese improve.
